subject: HANDOFF: make PanelEngine peer-role observation fresh and order-independent
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-performance-rd-panel-role-remap-coherence-20261002. WORKSTREAM_STATE=RND_COMPLETE. FINAL_VERIFIED_MAIN_SHA=7a612a0fe3181768f548a1ec78d2c3ee5938a339. STRONGEST_FINDING=hasLiveInnerElsewhere reads peer.innerPanel cache while each peer refreshes only when evaluated, so remap behavior depends on engine order; exact shader model shows 89.5 max frost vs 0 at 150deg for identical fresh topology. RECOMMENDED_FIRST_ITERATION=replace peer cached-role read with peer current Display.isInnerPanel() geometry (minimal diff included), then add an order-invariance test and Fold7 diagnostics. DO_NOT_CHANGE=shell lease/CAS, privileged cover owner, terminal handoff, angle source, content freshness. NEGATIVE_RESULT=initial coverRouteReassert single-flight starvation focus was superseded after shell mutation serialization/token review. DEVICE_VALIDATION_REQUIRED=confirm a both-panels-live Fold7 remap window under autonomous/fallback rendering and measure visible impact. No production write was performed. PRIMARY_ACTION_REQUIRED=independently revalidate against integration head (especially after Gen3 Alpha1 V3 lands), apply the small peer-geometry change if accepted, run unit/build tests, then field-test rapid folds/remaps.
